description: Full record for one ontology class by its IRI — preferred label, every synonym, the curated definition, semantic types, obsolescence flag, and links to parents and children. AUTHORITATIVE for the canonical meaning of a coded concept. Pass the ontology acronym and the class IRI exactly as bioportal_search returned it.

_apiKey.description: Your own BioPortal API key (free, https://bioportal.bioontology.org/accounts/new). Optional — without one the call uses a shared key that NCBO rate-limits across all of its users.

class_id.description: Full class IRI as returned by bioportal_search, e.g. "http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl#C3224"

name: bioportal_class
title: Bioportal Class
